name: sa-doc-reviewer
description: SA-focused document review combining general quality checks, SOW consulting review, and AWS cost estimate validation. Use whenever an SA or Aivar team member wants to review, audit, proofread, or QA any document before customer delivery — even if they say "check this doc", "review for quality", "is this ready to send", "review this SOW", "check my estimate", "run a quality check", "does this look right", "proofread this", "review before I share", or "SA checklist". Trigger when any DOCX, PDF, TX
